english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. His father was slain a year ago when the Dark Knights Loslorien attacked Golyat. With his mother already dead, he was left an orphan.
  He came to deeply resent the Bakram and Galgastani for their oppression of the Walister, and resolved to fight for his people's freedom.
spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que crecio junto a {hero}. Su padre murio hace doce meses al atacar Golyat los Caballeros Oscuros Loslorien. Sin madre, quedo huerfano.                           
  Guardo gran rencor a Bakram y Galgastani por oprimir a los walister, y decidio luchar por la libertad de su gente.

english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who grew up with {hero}. He was formerly the leader of the New Walister Alliance.
  Together with {hero} he rescued Duke Ronwey and joined the Walister Resistance. He later broke his ties with the Resistance after strongly opposing the massacre of innocent Walister at Balmamusa. He went on to form the New Walister Alliance to champion Walister self-rule and break the nobility's grip on power, earning much favor from his people.
  He eventually reconciled with the Resistance when {hero} took up its leadership. His might in arms served the Order of {order} well, helping bring the war to an end.
spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que crecio junto a {hero}. Fue el lider de la Nueva Alianza Walister.                
  Junto con {hero} libero al duque Ronwey y se unio a la Resistencia Walister. Rompio lazos con la Resistencia al oponerse con firmeza a la matanza de walister inocentes en Balmamusa. Luego fundo la Nueva Alianza Walister para buscar la autogestion walister y arrebatar el poder a la nobleza, ganandose el favor del pueblo.                          
  Al final se reconcilio con la Resistencia cuando {hero} tomo el mando. Su fuerza sirvio a la Orden de {order}, ayudando a poner fin a la guerra.

  The Duke rewarded his loyalty by appointing him the leader of the Resistance's Third Spear.
spanish:
Walister de Golyat que se crio con {hero}. Juntos liberaron al duque Ronwey y se unieron a la Resistencia Walister. Participo en la matanza de walister inocentes en Balmamusa pese a la oposicion de {hero}, lo que creo una brecha entre ambos.      
  El duque premio su lealtad al nombrarlo lider de la Tercera Lanza de la Resistencia.
